items.headline: Scottie Scheffler’s FedEx Win
items.text: Scottie Scheffler secured his second PGA Tour victory of the season at the FedEx St. Jude, returning to his dominant form.

items.headline: Jon Rahm’s PGA Tour Return
items.text: Jon Rahm is set to return to the PGA Tour in 2027 after agreeing to conditions including a $25 million charity payment, no sponsor exemptions in Signature Events, and issuing an apology for leaving LIV Golf.
